briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P500 +0.3%) with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. With $1089 in cash and 3 open slots, we made two modest, medium-conviction additions (HSAI, AGNC) from the strongest non-overbought setups rather than deploying aggressively, keeping the bulk of existing winners untouched per prior lessons on not overtrading neutral days.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means checking multiple indicators together — like RSI, MACD, and price versus a moving average — before trusting a bullish signal. A stock with RSI in the 55-70 'healthy' range, a bullish MACD crossover, and price above its 20-day average is showing broader agreement that buyers are in control, which is more reliable than any single indicator alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在信任一個買入訊號之前，同時檢查多個技術指標，例如RSI、MACD和股價與移動平均線的關係。當一隻股票的RSI處於55至70的「健康」區間、MACD出現黃金交叉，且股價高於20日平均線時，這代表多項指標一致顯示買方佔優，比單一指標更具參考價值。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices were essentially flat today, with the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the NASDAQ up just 0.1%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to a major catalyst. No single large news event drove price action, and the modest gains likely reflect routine trading rather than a shift in sentiment. This kind of low-volatility, directionless session is common between major economic data releases or earnings reports.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤表現平淡，標普500指數僅升0.3%，納斯達克指數更只微升0.1%，顯示投資者普遍處於觀望狀態，未見明顯催化劑帶動走勢。市場上並無重大新聞事件主導價格變化，溫和的升幅較大機會只是常規交易所致，而非市場情緒出現轉向。這種低波動、方向不明確的交易日，通常出現在重要經濟數據或財報公佈之間的空檔期。

trades.reasoning: RSI 60.3 in bullish zone with MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram, and price above SMA-20 signal healthy momentum without being overbought.

Lowest RSI (57.9) among the top-scored candidates with full bullish signal confirmation, offering room to run before overbought and a more defensive REIT profile to diversify the momentum-heavy portfolio.
